_comment: Manual per-game line overrides for the weekly pick sheet, keyed by ESPN game_id. 'market' = home-relative closing/kickoff market spread (negative = home team favored); used to freeze a line once ESPN drops its odds after kickoff. 'neutral' = force neutral-site (HFA=0) when ESPN's own neutralSite flag is missing. 'market_note' documents the source.
